Q1.problem_type_and_essence: thin-structure segmentation under structured visual artifacts with weak/unclear label provenance

input_target_constraints.input: 244x1350 unfolded borehole images and, if available, independently created fracture masks
input_target_constraints.target: binary fracture mask / connected fracture instances
hard_constraints: freeze image/borehole split before threshold/weight fitting
ground-truth mask provenance must be explicit
augmentation/crops from one original image cannot cross folds

baseline.name: Frangi/Canny/black-hat + morphology + connected-component rules
six_hour_plan: run 2-3 complementary ridge/edge detectors rather than all six initially
evaluate on a small independently labeled holdout using IoU/F1 plus per-image errors
baseline.why: fast, transparent and does not require a large annotation set

author_route.method: six-method pixel vote followed by 12-feature manually weighted connected-component score, keep score>=6/10
advantages: two-stage design can favor recall first then precision
risks: three-image pixel metrics may be optimistic if used during design

alternatives.model: logistic regression / shallow tree / RandomForest on the same 12 component features
alternatives.use_when: a modest labeled set exists; learns weights while retaining interpretability
enough independent pixel masks across boreholes exist and held-out gain is stable

not_recommended_default: large vision model without enough independent labels
reporting only pixel accuracy because background TN dominates
Q1.switch_condition: promote learned segmentation only if grouped held-out IoU/F1 materially and stably beats the classical baseline under comparable annotation/runtime budget

Q2.problem_type_and_essence: unknown-count fracture-instance grouping followed by robust geometry-constrained periodic curve fitting

input_target_constraints.input: binary fracture pixels converted to mm (about 0.386 mm/pixel horizontal, 0.370 mm/pixel vertical for the 244x1350 images)
hard_constraints: period is tied to borehole circumference when diameter/calibration is known
fit quality and physical plausibility gate

baseline.name: component/DBSCAN merge + fixed-period bounded robust least squares
six_hour_plan: set P=pi*D or calibrated horizontal span
fit R,beta,C with scipy least_squares soft_l1 or RANSAC+refit
baseline.why: uses the cylindrical geometry and has fewer degrees of freedom than a free-period model

author_route.method: Model 1 DBSCAN + horizontal-band merge + RANSAC/LS free R/P/beta/C; Model 2 adaptive sliding window + reduced Hough with fixed P; Table 6 selects Model 1
advantages: model-family comparison rather than one method only
risks: free-period values 80-110 mm are not reconciled with known circumference

alternatives.use_when: fracture count varies and DBSCAN epsilon is unstable
occlusion/outliers make direct initialization unstable and circumference is known

not_recommended_default: free 4-parameter sinusoid when period is physically fixed without evidence of calibration distortion
claiming superiority from p-values whose test/sample units are unspecified
Q2.switch_condition: allow free period only if image calibration/cylinder geometry is uncertain and held-out residuals show material improvement beyond fixed-period fit

Q3.problem_type_and_essence: multiscale roughness representation and numerical-integration/sampling sensitivity rather than purely predictive ML

input_target_constraints.input: ordered physical fracture centerline/profile in mm
input_target_constraints.target: JRC and uncertainty/sensitivity of its numerical estimate
hard_constraints: sampling reference must be labeled numerical reference unless external ground truth exists

baseline.name: ordered centerline + canonical Z2/JRC + sampling-density convergence
six_hour_plan: add adaptive sampling only if equal-spacing convergence is inadequate
baseline.why: directly answers roughness sensitivity with minimal unsupported corrections

author_route.method: K=4 Fourier main contour + 4-level DWT detail + Bootstrap + equal/curvature/gradient/entropy sampling + RAF-corrected JRC
advantages: uncertainty language via Bootstrap is directionally useful
risks: LS vs MLE estimator drift in Bootstrap pseudocode
Q4 later uses inconsistent JRC scale

alternatives.use_when: goal is computational efficiency and dense-grid convergence is available as a numerical reference

not_recommended_default: declaring adaptive sampling more accurate without external truth
copying RAF coefficients to new rock/image scales without calibration
Q3.switch_condition: promote Fourier+DWT/RAF only if held-out or external roughness evidence shows stable gain over canonical JRC and coefficients are calibrated train-only

Q4.problem_type_and_essence: sparse-observation 3D geometry inference plus measurement-location design under epistemic uncertainty and hard construction constraints

input_target_constraints.input: attachment-derived fracture geometry/JRC from six known boreholes
input_target_constraints.target: connectivity relation/score, uncertainty or coverage field, and feasible supplementary locations
input_target_constraints.independent_evaluation_unit: fracture pair / spatial cell / candidate borehole
hard_constraints: do not call uncalibrated heuristic score probability
uncertainty semantics must match a stochastic model or be labeled coverage surrogate
500 mm safety spacing must specify new-new and existing-new sets

baseline.name: transparent geometry compatibility + distance coverage score + feasible greedy placement
six_hour_plan: score distance/orientation/depth with interpretable monotone factors
call output compatibility unless labels allow calibration
enumerate feasible candidate grid and greedy maximize coverage reduction with explicit all-hole spacing replay
baseline.why: works without pretending to have field connectivity labels or a Bayesian observation model

author_route.method: five-factor multiplicative connectivity 'probability' + DFS threshold 0.3 + exponential information-decay/IDW 'uncertainty' + sequential greedy 'information gain'
risks: formal spacing constraint omits existing-new interactions

alternatives.use_when: connectivity labels or defensible priors/likelihoods are available

alternatives.model: Gaussian process / spatial random field + expected variance reduction
alternatives.use_when: a continuous geostatistical target with variogram/measurement model is available
probabilistic calibration is impossible but engineering preferences are explicit

not_recommended_default: multiplying arbitrary [0,1] factors and calling the product calibrated probability
calling deterministic hotspot reduction expected information gain
Q4.switch_condition: use Bayesian/EIG language only after defining priors, observation likelihood/update and evaluating calibration; otherwise retain score/coverage terminology
